python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
with open('answers.jsonl','a') as f:
 for n,c in enumerate(['ь','ъъъь','ъьъ','ьъъьъъ'],91):
  r=rows[n-1];f.write(json.dumps(dict(item_id=r['item_id'],slots={str(i):x for i,x in enumerate(c,1)},confidence={str(i):'high' for i in range(1,len(c)+1)},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918='no' if n==91 else 'yes',note=''),ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
answers=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(rows)==len(answers)
counts=collections.Counter()
for r,a in zip(rows,answers):
 assert r['item_id']==a['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,r['slots']+1)}
 assert set(a['slots'])==expected
 assert set(a['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(x in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for x in a['slots'].values())
 assert all(x in ['high','low'] for x in a['confidence'].values())
 assert a['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
 counts.update(a['slots'].values())
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for a in answers:f.write(json.dumps(a,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print('Validated count, order, and slot coverage:',len(answers),'items')
print('Slot calls:',dict(counts),'total',sum(counts.values()))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for a in answers))
